hook_text: A R240 jacket with a quarter off. Do you pay R60? Read it again.
clip_script: Kroonstad, a class of 36 learners. Three quarters walk to school. How many? Share 36 into 4 groups: 9 in each. That is one quarter. Three quarters: 3 times 9, 27 learners. How many do not walk? The other quarter: 9. 27 plus 9 is 36. Now the sale: a R240 jacket, a quarter off. A quarter of 240 is 60. Is the price R60? No, that is the discount. Pay R240 minus R60: R180. Divide by the bottom, times the top, then read the question again.
visual_style: 36 dots sharing into 4 circles, three circles lighting up, then a price tag with a quarter sliced off.
mood: Sharp and helpful, like a friend who checks the till slip.
pacing: Share, multiply, rest; then the discount trap and the correct price.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find 2/3 of the number of days in June.
